concerns.text: Duplicate functional requirement identifier **FR-001** appears both in the main Functional Requirements section (Data Ingestion Scope) and again as a placeholder in the Spec Template. This creates ambiguity about which definition is authoritative.
Placeholder functional requirements **FR-001** through **FR-005** in the Spec Template are not anchored to any user story, leaving them orphaned and unused.
Placeholder success criteria **SC-001** through **SC-004** in the Spec Template are not linked to any user story, making them orphaned.
